items.headline: Singapore upgrades 2026 growth forecast to 4.5-5.5% after Q2 GDP jumps 5.9%
items.summary: MTI raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 4.5%-5.5% after Q2 grew 5.9% y/y; Enterprise Singapore lifted the NODX forecast to 14%-16%.

items.headline: 2.4 million Singaporeans to receive S$400-S$600 cost-of-living payment from Sept 9
items.summary: Over 2.4 million citizens aged 21+ get S$400-S$600 under the Budget 2026 Cost-of-Living Special Payment from Sept 9; PayNow-NRIC by Aug 30 for earliest payout.

items.headline: Xinmin Secondary School evacuated after bomb threat; no device found
items.summary: Xinmin Secondary in Hougang was evacuated on Aug 13 after a bomb threat; police found no device and are investigating false information of a harmful thing.

items.headline: Eleven arrested over unlicensed moneylending syndicate tied to 25,500 scam reports
items.summary: Eight men and three women aged 18-77 arrested for aiding an unlicensed moneylending syndicate linked to 25,500 ScamShield reports and 1,509 police reports.

items.headline: Ex-NEC sales manager jailed four years for cheating firms of S$726,000
items.summary: Seno Kunihide, 50, ex-NEC Asia Pacific sales manager, jailed four years for cheating and forgery causing over S$726,000 in losses.

items.headline: RBI turns upbeat as Iran-war shock fades, citing record vehicle sales and strong credit
items.summary: The RBI's monthly bulletin struck a confident tone: worst West Asia inflation/growth fears did not materialise; record vehicle sales, credit growth at a two-year high, July CPI within the 2-6% band.

items.headline: India desk coverage limited in today's edition
items.summary: India's primary outlets were unreachable from the routine's network and fallback newswires could not be searched; major stories (Monsoon Session sine die; Delhi Independence Day security) were held rather than linked to an unverifiable source.

items.headline: 'Exceptionally serious' drought hits UK farmers as heatwave persists
items.summary: An escalating drought is squeezing UK farmers after the driest July on record; over half the winter wheat harvested by late July, much of England under water restrictions, London hit 38.1C.

items.headline: Thames Water warned nationalisation could cost £140bn as rescue deal stalls
items.summary: Thames Water (~£18.5bn net debt) was told public ownership could cost ~£140bn; creditors including Elliott and Silver Point offer ~£3.35bn equity as ministers ready a special-administration contingency.

items.headline: UK economy grew 0.4% in the second quarter, beating forecasts
items.summary: UK GDP rose 0.4% q/q in Q2 (down from 0.6% in Q1) versus a roughly flat forecast; business investment +1.7%, June output +0.3%; analysts flag one-off boosts.

items.headline: UK hiring held steady in July after a four-year downturn
items.summary: Payrolled employment fell just 4,000 in June (vs 8,000 expected), suggesting labour-market stabilisation; private-sector wage growth at its weakest since 2020.

items.headline: Venezuela and Israel restore consular ties after 17-year rupture
items.summary: Venezuela and Israel agreed on Aug 11 to re-establish consular services, ending a break dating to 2009 over the Gaza war; a notable realignment for Caracas.

items.headline: Pentagon review finds US strikes killed 153 civilians in Yemen in 2025
items.summary: An unclassified Pentagon assessment to Congress found US 2025 strikes on the Houthis killed 153 civilians and wounded 243, nearly all in three April strikes; the Ras Isa port strike killed 80.

items.headline: Russia bars Yabloko, its only anti-war party, from September elections
items.summary: Russia's Supreme Court annulled liberal Yabloko's candidate list on Aug 10 ahead of the Sept 18-20 Duma vote, upholding a pro-Kremlin Rodina suit; Yabloko vowed to appeal.

items.headline: Yemeni forces repel Houthi assault near Taiz as fighting intensifies
items.summary: Yemeni government forces said they repelled a Houthi attack on the al-Mafalis front near Taiz on Aug 13 amid the sharpest escalation since the 2022 truce.

items.headline: Google unveils Pixel 11 lineup with Tensor G6 and deeper Gemini AI
items.summary: Google announced the Pixel 11, 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL on Aug 12 with the Tensor G6 chip and heavier Gemini integration; prices from $899/$1,099/$1,299, shipping Aug 20.

items.headline: AI app-builder Lovable doubles valuation to $13.3bn in $400m raise
items.summary: Lovable confirmed a $400m Series C led by Menlo Ventures, doubling its December valuation to $13.3bn; added Tencent and Balderton after hitting a $500m ARR run rate in June.

items.headline: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation jumps nearly tenfold to $550m
items.summary: Blacksmith raised a $45m Series B led by Peak XV at a $550m valuation (up from $60m); it validates AI-generated code for 5,000+ customers including Mercury and Supabase.

items.headline: Vantage Data Centers explores IPO at about $100bn valuation
items.summary: Silver Lake- and DigitalBridge-backed Vantage is weighing an IPO that could raise ~$10bn at ~$100bn valuation; recently partnered with Oracle and OpenAI on a US Stargate campus.

items.headline: Crypto hardware maker Trezor says shipping-partner breach exposed thousands
items.summary: Trezor disclosed a shipping-provider breach exposing personal data of 11,742 customers (plus ~2,000 partially); those who ordered within 90 days before Aug 8 affected; funds/devices safe.

items.headline: S&P 500 tops 7,800 for the first time after soft producer-price data
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed at a record 7,798.99 on Aug 13 as cooler PPI lifted rate-hold hopes; the Nasdaq rose ~0.8% to 26,803 and the Dow added ~70 points.

items.headline: US wholesale prices were flat in July as inflation pressures eased
items.summary: July PPI was unchanged (below the 0.2% expected), slowing the annual rate to 4.7% from 5.5%; a 3.1% energy drop dragged goods lower, giving the Fed room to hold.

items.headline: Cisco slides about 8% despite an earnings beat and strong AI-order guidance
items.summary: Cisco posted Q4 revenue of $17.3bn (+18% y/y) and adjusted EPS of $1.22, both beats, and guided FY27 revenue above $72bn, but fell ~8% on softer gross-margin guidance of 65-66%.

items.headline: Oil falls as OPEC and the IEA cut their 2026 demand forecasts
items.summary: Brent fell ~1.5% to $87.69 and WTI to ~$81.97 on Aug 13 after OPEC and the IEA trimmed 2026 demand outlooks; a 17.4m-barrel US crude build added pressure.

items.headline: Shelton and Nakashima set all-American Montreal final; Rybakina meets Swiatek in Toronto
items.summary: Ben Shelton beat Learner Tien 6-2, 6-3 and Brandon Nakashima beat Rafael Jodar for an all-American Montreal final; in Toronto, Rybakina beat Gauff 5-7, 6-2, 6-2 to face Swiatek. (Semi-final results; finals results not retrievable this run.)

items.headline: Sinner and Alcaraz both withdraw from the Cincinnati Open before the US Open
items.summary: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner (right knee) withdrew from the Cincinnati Open, joining defending champion Carlos Alcaraz (right wrist); both head into the US Open (Aug 30) without a hard-court warm-up.

items.headline: Trent Rockets top both Hundred tables and go straight to the Lord's finals
items.summary: Trent Rockets finished first in both the men's and women's Hundred, reaching the Aug 16 Lord's finals directly; the Aug 14 eliminators decide their opponents.

items.headline: F1 silly season heats up over the break with Cadillac's 2027 seats in play
items.summary: In the F1 summer break, focus is on the 2027 grid: Mercedes working to retain George Russell and Kimi Antonelli, Cadillac weighing its two open seats, Verstappen set to stay at Red Bull with Hadjar.

items.headline: How fast the climate warms, not just how much, may decide if the AMOC collapses
items.summary: A Utrecht team (Rene van Westen) reports in Nature Climate Change that AMOC stability depends on warming speed: collapse near 2C under fast warming but stable to 5.5C when slow; critical rate ~0.3C/decade.

items.headline: JWST spots a 'black hole star' at cosmic dawn, hinting at a new class of object
items.summary: Astronomers (Rohan Naidu) describe MoM-BH*-1, seen 660m years after the Big Bang: a supermassive black hole in dense gas with a huge Balmer break; may explain JWST's 'little red dots'.

items.headline: Physicists use light to glimpse electrons frozen in a 'Wigner crystal'
items.summary: A Basel-TU Munich team reports in Nature Physics that they probed a Wigner crystal via 'Wigner crystal polarons' — hybrid light-matter states — in a tungsten-diselenide monolayer.

items.headline: Severe COVID can reawaken dormant viruses, study links it to long COVID
items.summary: A multi-omic study of 1,154 hospitalised COVID patients found nearly half reactivated latent viruses (Epstein-Barr, anelloviruses, CMV); anellovirus reactivation correlated with long COVID.

fun_fact.headline: A googol is bigger than the number of atoms in the observable universe
fun_fact.body: A googol (1 followed by 100 zeros) is far larger than the estimated number of atoms in the observable universe (about 10^80). Even that is dwarfed by the googolplex. The word was coined in 1938 by nine-year-old Milton Sirotta, nephew of mathematician Edward Kasner.
fun_fact.source: Kasner & Newman, Mathematics and the Imagination; standard cosmology estimates

puzzle.title: Who Ate the Cake?
puzzle.body: Four children (Priya, Quinn, Rohan, Sam); exactly one took the cake and exactly one of four statements is true. Priya: Quinn took it. Quinn: Sam took it. Rohan: I didn't take it. Sam: Quinn is lying.
puzzle.approach: Find two statements that contradict each other to locate the single true statement.
puzzle.answer: Rohan. Quinn and Sam contradict, so the one true statement is among them, forcing Priya and Rohan false; Priya false means Quinn didn't take it, Rohan false means Rohan did. Sam's statement is the true one.

word_puzzle.title: Picture This
word_puzzle.body: Spelling Bee. Centre letter T; outer letters C, A, P, I, O, N. Make 4+ letter words using only these seven; one pangram uses all seven.
word_puzzle.approach: Every word must contain T; find the seven-letter pangram.
word_puzzle.answer: Pangram CAPTION. Others: TACO, COAT, ATOP, OPTIC, TOPIC, TONIC, PATIO, ANTIC, TITAN, ACTION, POTION, CATNIP, CAPTAIN, POTATO.
